verses.text: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place In all generations.

segments.text: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling-place
In all generations.

verses.text: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

segments.text: Before the mountains were brought forth,
Or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world,
Even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

verses.text: Thou turnest man to destruction, And sayest, Return, ye children of men.

segments.text: Thou turnest man to destruction,
And sayest, Return, ye children of men.

verses.text: For a thousand years in thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.

segments.text: For a thousand years in thy sight
Are but as yesterday when it is past,
And as a watch in the night.

verses.text: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

segments.text: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep:
In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.

verses.text: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

segments.text: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up;
In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

verses.text: For we are consumed in thine anger, And in thy wrath are we troubled.

segments.text: For we are consumed in thine anger,
And in thy wrath are we troubled.

verses.text: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

segments.text: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee,
Our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

verses.text: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

segments.text: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath:
We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

verses.text: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow; For it is soon gone, and we fly away.

segments.text: The days of our years are threescore years and ten,
Or even by reason of strength fourscore years;
Yet is their pride but labor and sorrow;
For it is soon gone, and we fly away.

verses.text: Who knoweth the power of thine anger, And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?

segments.text: Who knoweth the power of thine anger,
And thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto thee?

verses.text: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.

segments.text: So teach us to number our days,
That we may get us a heart of wisdom.

verses.text: Return, O Jehovah; how long? And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

segments.text: Return, O Jehovah; how long?
And let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

verses.text: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

segments.text: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness,
That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.text: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us, And the years wherein we have seen evil.

segments.text: Make us glad according to the days wherein thou hast afflicted us,
And the years wherein we have seen evil.

verses.text: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, And thy glory upon their children.

segments.text: Let thy work appear unto thy servants,
And thy glory upon their children.

verses.text: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us; And establish thou the work of our hands upon us; Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

segments.text: And let the favor of the Lord our God be upon us;
And establish thou the work of our hands upon us;
Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

headings.text: A Prayer of Moses the man of God.
